title: General Counsel (remote)
description: We are hiring a General Counsel , reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function. This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly. In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and judgement alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment. Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones. The role entails Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas. Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly. Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team. Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance. Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings. Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed. Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed. Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation. Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality. Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows. What We Are Looking For In You An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university. A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction. Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business. Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones. A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out. Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel. Technology related experience of: negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate. Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls. Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes. Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation. Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills. Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability. International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long. Nice-to-have Skills Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company. A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how

title: Senior Accountant
description: MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Senior Accountant will provide overall financial management support to the America First Global Health Strategy project office in ensuring all financial transactions follow MSH financial policies and procedures. He/she ensures that all payments/disbursements, accounting, and financial records are maintained in accordance with MSH policies and donor rules and regulations. He/she makes sure that all government taxes and other obligations are deducted and paid on time. Specific Responsibilities Oversee the overall financial activities in the project to ensure activities are following MSH policies and procedures, Donors’ rules and regulations, and statutory obligations. Ensure all transactions have the necessary approval, are accurately coded and charged to the right expenditure type, with appropriate documentation, and are recorded into the QuickBooks database. Prepare check payments, bank transfers, and bank letters in the name of authorized payees/vendors as necessary. Facilitate online and internet banking payments. Review petty cash payments and replenishment requests to ensure they are in line with MSH Ethiopia Petty cash policies. Assist the issuance and administration of local sub-awards and fixed obligation grants. Prepare monthly payroll and benefits, and process timely payment based on MSH and Government applicable policies as appropriate. Effect workshop, training, or similar event payments as necessary in accordance with MSH Ethiopia workshop administration policy and procedures. Follow the timely settlement of outstanding work and staff advances prepare aging analysis report and submit to MSH Country and Regional Offices monthly as appropriate. Assist the Senior Finance Manager with monthly financial closing, preparation of monthly financial reports, and any communications. Provide preparation of provident fund and government payables (such as withholding tax, income tax, and pension) and make sure that such payables are paid to the appropriate authority on time. Assist the Finance Coordinator on VAT claims and refund submission. Assist in the preparation and smooth conduct of internal and external audits. Prepare/review payment vouchers, cash receipts vouchers, and journal vouchers in accordance with MSH policies and procedures. Review and post PV's, JV's, PCPV's & DV's on a daily basis Review subcontract invoices before payment and ensure the maintenance of proper documentation of all subcontract documents and communication. Perform other duties that are in line with the scope of the position as assigned by his/her supervisor Qualifications REQUIRED MINIMUM EDUCATION Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business management, or related field from a recognized university. Required Minimum Experience Bachelor's and 4-6 years of experience, or Master-s and 2-4 years of experience. Previous experience in USAID-funded projects of similar nature, and good knowledge of USAID rules and regulations. Experience working on local and international sub-grant management is an advantage Knowledge & Skills Excellent interpersonal skills: demonstrated ability to interact professionally with culturally diverse staff, clients, and consultants. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and able to meet deadlines with attention to detail and quality English and local language fluency including business terminology required. Good computer skills in Microsoft Office suite application, and familiar with QuickBooks or similar accounting software. MSH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. MSH complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, Section 4212 of the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act, as amended, and all related applicable regulations. title: Front Desk Officer
description: Category: Sales and Marketing Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Career Level: Junior Level (0–2 years) : Fresh Graduates are preferred Employment Type: Full-Time Salary: Negotiable Job Summary We are seeking a professional and personable Front Desk Officer to serve as the primary point of contact for clients and visitors in our real estate office. This role involves greeting clients, managing inquiries, coordinating property viewings, and providing comprehensive administrative support to the Marketing and Sales teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong customer service skills with a proactive attitude and a polished professional presence, ensuring a positive client experience while supporting daily office operations. Position in the Organization This position reports directly to the Sales and Marketing Manager. The Front Desk Officer is expected to carry out all assigned duties efficiently and professionally under the guidance of the immediate Line Manager. Key Responsibilities 1. Greet and assist clients, visitors, and vendors with a friendly, professional, and welcoming demeanor. 2. Answer and manage incoming calls, emails, and inquiries, directing them to the appropriate team members in a timely manner. 3. Maintain an organized, clean, and welcoming front desk environment that reflects the company’s professional image. 4. Coordinate appointments, meetings, and property viewings for the Marketing/Sales Manager and real estate agents. 5. Assist in creating and distributing marketing materials, including property listings and promotional content. 6. Support the execution of open houses, promotional events, and other marketing activities. 7. Communicate with clients regarding property inquiries, showing schedules, and feedback. 8. Handle administrative tasks such as filing, data entry, managing listings, and maintaining databases. 9. Arrange travel, transportation, and logistics as required by the Manager and team. 10. Proactively remind the Manager of important tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups. 11. Prepare reports, correspondence, and documentation with accuracy and attention to detail. 12. Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion. 13. Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned by the Manager to support the Marketing & Sales Department. Job Requirements • Bachelor’s Degree (BA) in Business Administration, Management, Marketing Management, or a related field. • 0–3 years of experience in a receptionist, front desk, or administrative role, preferably in a customer-facing or real estate environment. • Ability and willingness to actively support the Marketing & Sales Department, including assisting with administrative tasks, client coordination, and day-to-day departmental needs. • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a genuine customer-service focus. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). • Familiarity with real estate software (e.g., MLS, CRM systems) is an advantage. Required Skills & Attributes • Energetic and Approachable Personality: Outgoing, positive, and naturally engaging with clients and visitors. • Professional Presence: Well-groomed appearance and polished demeanor that reflects the organization’s image. • Customer Service Orientation: Ability to create a welcoming environment and deliver excellent service. • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication to interact effectively with clients, vendors, and team members. • Organizational & Multitasking Ability: Capable of managing multiple tasks, prioritizing effectively, and thriving in a fast-paced environment. • Attention to Detail: Keen eye for accuracy in documentation, correspondence, and marketing materials. • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to address issues proactively and find practical solutions. • Team Collaboration: Works effectively with the marketing and sales team as well as other departments. • Time Management & Adaptability: Manages time efficiently and adjusts to changing priorities in a dynamic real estate environment. • Integrity & Discretion: Handles confidential information responsibly and maintains high ethical standards. How to Apply Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated resume and a cover letter to: Hr@metropolitanaddis.net Please use the subject line: “Application for Front Desk Officer”.

title: Accountant
description: Company Description A Poultry Farm Management organization specializes in overseeing the full cycle of poultry production, from animal care and feeding to product collection and distribution. The company focuses on efficient farm operations, cost control, and high-quality output to meet growing market demand. Team members work in a dynamic agricultural environment where accuracy, safety, and responsible resource management are essential. The organization values reliability, ethical conduct, and continuous improvement in both farm and financial operations. Role Description The Accountant will manage day-to-day financial activities for the poultry farm, ensuring accurate recording, reporting, and analysis of all transactions. This full-time, on-site role is based in Ziway and involves maintaining general ledgers, preparing financial statements, and reconciling accounts. The Accountant will track costs related to feed, livestock, labor, and supplies, assist with budgeting and forecasting, and monitor cash flow. The role includes preparing tax-related documents, supporting audits, and ensuring compliance with relevant financial regulations and company policies. The Accountant will collaborate closely with farm management to provide financial insights that support operational decisions and long-term planning. Qualifications Solid knowledge of accounting principles, including general ledger management, financial reporting, and account reconciliation. Experience with budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis in an operational or production environment (agriculture or manufacturing experience is an advantage). Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel, including spreadsheets, formulas, and basic data analysis tools. Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and ability to identify discrepancies in financial records. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-finance team members. Ability to work on-site in Ziway, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CPA or equivalent) are a plus. Demonstrated integrity, confidentiality in handling financial data, and commitment to ethical financial practices.

title: Communications Officer (Videography & Video Editing)
description: Job Highlight This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled videographer/video editor to contribute directly to UNOPS HAMCO's strategic communication efforts, creating impactful visual stories that highlight development initiatives across the Horn of Africa. The role offers a chance to apply creative and technical expertise in a dynamic international development context, making a tangible difference in communicating the organization's mission and vision. Role Purpose The Communications Officer (Videographer/Video Editor) applies fundamental concepts of videography and video editing to produce high-quality, engaging visual content that supports UNOPS HAMCO's communication objectives. This role involves gathering and interpreting requirements, executing intricate production tasks, and making initial recommendations to ensure all video outputs effectively convey the organization's mission and adhere to established standards. Functions / Key Results Expected Video Content Production and Editing Conduct on-location and remote filming and editing of promotional features, video explainers, interviews with UNOPS HAMCO personnel, stakeholders, partners and community members, as well as coverage of HAMCO portfolio projects. Apply technical expertise in videography and editing to produce high-quality video features using raw footage provided by UNOPS. Film and edit video messages recorded through online meeting platforms, such as Google Meet. Quality Assurance and Compliance Review and apply UNOPS branding guidelines, including requirements relating to fonts, colours and logo placement, to ensure that all video productions comply with organizational standards. Identify and address discrepancies relating to audiovisual quality, branding or other compliance requirements, ensuring that all final videos are of broadcast quality. Ensure that all soundtrack music is appropriately licensed or free for commercial use, and provide proof of licensing or source links, as required. Collaboration and Conceptual Contribution Collaborate with the Communications Specialist to interpret communication objectives and standards and contribute to the visual storytelling approach for each video project. Provide inputs to project planning and execution, including initial recommendations on visual content and production techniques to enhance audience engagement. Content Management and Archiving Gather and organize raw footage, edited videos, additional B-roll and shoot notes for archiving purposes, ensuring clear labelling and compliance with the required technical and file formats, including 1920 × 1080-pixel resolution in MP4 or MOV format. Submit versions of all final videos both with and without subtitles. Synchronize and merge audio tracks with the corresponding video footage when the audio and video are recorded separately. Education Requirements Required Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience combinations: High School or Secondary School Diploma with six (6) years of relevant experience. Technical/Professional Diploma with four (4) years of relevant experience; OR Bachelor’s degree or Bachelor's equivalent with two (2) years of relevant experience; OR Desired A Masters, Degree in in film, video production or a related field is desired. Required Experience Requirements Relevant experience is work in video production across a variety of contexts, such as video explainers, testimonials, public service announcements, documentaries or educational content is required. 2 years of experience in developing video content and formats for Social Media required. 2 years of experience in filming, editing and producing high-quality video content is required. Proficiency in professional video-editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or similar software, is required. 2 years experience in visual storytelling and creating engaging content tailored to the intended audience is required. Des ired Previous experience working with UNOPS or another United Nations organization is desired.
